name: 陳家興
objective:
This course integrates Smart Space design, the Internet of Things (IoT), Information Visualization, UAV-based Spatial Observation, and Agentic AI technologies within the context of a Smart Campus. Students will learn how to collect, analyze, interpret, and utilize spatial and environmental data to develop intelligent interactive systems capable of autonomous sensing, reasoning, planning, and decision-making.
The course covers multiple sources of spatial data, including environmental sensors, mobile device sensors, and unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs). Students will explore techniques for data acquisition, cloud-based data synchronization, information visualization, and interactive interface design. Building upon these foundations, the course introduces Generative AI and Agentic AI concepts to develop Smart Campus Agents that can observe environments, understand contexts, plan actions, and provide intelligent services.
Through hands-on projects, students will utilize Arduino Nano 33 BLE Sense Rev2, JavaScript, Firebase, GitHub, and Gemini API to design and implement smart space applications. The course emphasizes interdisciplinary integration of interactive design, smart technologies, spatial computing, and artificial intelligence.
Adopting a project-based learning approach, students will develop practical skills in environmental sensing, data visualization, human-AI interaction, and intelligent system development. By the end of the course, students will be able to design and build Smart Campus Agents that support applications such as environmental monitoring, campus navigation, learning space recommendation, energy management, and smart healthcare services.
---------------------------------------------------------------
本課程結合智慧空間（Smart Space）、物聯網（IoT）、資訊視覺化（Information Visualization）、無人機空間觀測（UAV-based Spatial Observation）與 Agentic AI 技術，透過智慧校園（Smart Campus）情境，引導學生學習如何蒐集、分析、理解與應用空間資料，並建構具備自主感知、推理與決策能力的智慧空間互動系統。
課程內容涵蓋環境感測器、行動裝置感測器與無人機等多元空間資料來源，學習資料蒐集、雲端資料同步、資訊視覺化及互動介面設計。進一步透過生成式人工智慧（Generative AI）與 Agentic AI 技術，建立能夠觀察環境（Observe）、理解情境（Reason）、規劃行動（Plan）及執行任務（Act）的智慧校園代理人（Smart Campus Agent）。
學生將利用 Arduino Nano 33 BLE Sense Rev2、JavaScript、Firebase、GitHub 與 Gemini API 等工具，完成智慧空間互動系統專題開發，培養智慧科技、互動設計與人工智慧整合應用能力。

延伸教學與資源: ● 數位科技融入 (Digital Technology Integration) 運用生成式 AI、VR/AR、IoT、IRS 等新興科技輔助教學與評量。Utilizes emerging technologies such as Generative AI, VR/AR, IoT, and IRS (Interactive Response Systems) to facilitate teaching and assessment.● 參與式創新教學 (Participatory & Innovative Teaching) 強調學生參與與產出，導入翻轉、PBL/專題、設計思考或遊戲化等策略。Emphasizes student engagement and outcomes by adopting strategies such as Flipped Classroom, PBL (Problem/Project- Based Learning), Design Thinking, or Gamification.
課程對應SDGs指標: SDG4：優質教育（Quality Education）SDG9：產業創新與基礎設施（Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure）SDG11：永續城市與社區（Sustainable Cities and Communities）
